content: While using this medication, it is essential to monitor specific health parameters, including blood pressure, heart rate and rhythm, kidney function, and blood mineral levels. Ensure that you attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. If a dose is missed, note that this drug is administered continuously as an infusion. For storage, refer to the product instructions and consult your pharmacist for detailed guidance. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. The information provided here was last updated in May 2024.
